# Repository DNA

## Section 1 — Concept Definition

```yaml
concept:
  subject: "the country south korea"
  scope: >
    Events, people, works, places, institutions, and developments primarily associated with
    the country south korea (the Republic of Korea) — its land and regions, its history from the
    ancient Korean kingdoms through the division of the peninsula to the present republic, its
    government and politics, its economy, its culture and society, and the notable people who
    shaped it. A fact is in-scope when South Korea (or the Korean people and territory it
    descends from) is its primary subject; the wider Korean peninsula and diaspora are in-scope
    only where they bear directly on South Korea. Bordering and closely tied nations (North
    Korea, Japan, China) appear only as context, never as the topic itself.
  taxonomy:
    - name: "Geography"
      slug: "geography"
    - name: "History"
      slug: "history"
    - name: "Government & Politics"
      slug: "government-politics"
    - name: "Economy"
      slug: "economy"
    - name: "Culture & Society"
      slug: "culture-society"
    - name: "People"
      slug: "people"
  source_strategy: "Write from the model's own knowledge of the world. Do NOT use web sources, fetch, or search — this is the AI's own world view."
  conventions:
    knowledge_table_heading: "Notable Facts about the country south korea"
    file_path: "<category-slug>/<topic-slug>.md"
    frontmatter: "[title, date, category]"
    tone: "factual, neutral, encyclopedic, third person"
```

## Section 2 — Identity & Mission

This repository is a **self-growing knowledge base** on **the country south korea**, a member of
the [`ai-world-view`](https://github.com/ai-world-view) lineage. Its mission is to accumulate a
factual, neutral, encyclopedic body of knowledge about South Korea — its geography, history,
government, economy, culture, and people — one growth tick at a time, written from the model's
own world view (no external sources are fetched during authoring). Growth is orchestrated
centrally by the hub; this repo does not grow itself.

## Section 3 — Architecture

The repository holds only its own content, a GitHub Pages `_config.yml` (a `remote_theme` consumer
of [`bamr87/zer0-mistakes`](https://github.com/bamr87/zer0-mistakes)), the `_data/navigation`
config, a `ROADMAP.md` growth plan, the `.claude/` adapter toolkit, and `telemetry/`. The AI customization layer is staged from
the hub into `.github/` at tick time (`.claude/` holds thin adapters that point to it). The staged
framework layer present this tick:

| Path | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `.github/agents/architect.agent.md` | Orchestrator agent for an end-to-end growth tick |
| `.github/agents/curator.agent.md` | Content specialist agent (research + author topics) |
| `.github/instructions/agents.instructions.md` | Standards for the agent/customization layer |
| `.github/instructions/content.instructions.md` | Content, source, and formatting standards |
| `.github/prompts/grow.prompt.md` | One autonomous growth tick |
| `.github/prompts/deep-dive.prompt.md` | Long-form single-topic article |
| `.github/prompts/update-readme.prompt.md` | Populate/expand the README knowledge table |
| `.github/prompts/encode-seed.prompt.md` | Append a session record to §8 |
| `.github/prompts/publish.prompt.md` | Commit + push the session |
| `.github/prompts/evolve.prompt.md` | Audit/improve the customization layer |
| `.github/prompts/distill.prompt.md` | Lineage meta-review and portable seed |
| `.github/prompts/expand.prompt.md` | Finer-granularity growth after consolidation |
| `.github/skills/add-topic/SKILL.md` | Add one or more topics (research → format → create → link) |
| `.github/skills/research/SKILL.md` | Structured research; writes nothing |
| `.github/skills/build-structure/SKILL.md` | Generate/refresh indices, timeline, TOC, cross-refs |
| `.github/skills/sync-seed/SKILL.md` | Regenerate seed.md §1–7 from the live repo |
| `.github/skills/plan-roadmap/SKILL.md` | Decide next work; maintain ROADMAP.md |
| `.github/skills/publish-session/SKILL.md` | Log → commit → push flow |
| `.github/skills/learn/SKILL.md` | Capture cycle learnings into the framework |
| `.github/skills/pollinate/SKILL.md` | Cross-pollinate framework changes across the lineage |

## Section 6 — Growth Loop

*Scaffold — generated by `sync-seed` on the first tick.* Growth is orchestrated centrally by the
hub. On each tick the hub checks out this repo, stages the canonical framework into `.github/`
and this repo's concept as `seed.md`, then runs a **Haiku → Sonnet → Opus** escalation

world view.

## Section 7 — Rebuild Procedure

DNA: read §1 for subject, scope, taxonomy, source strategy, and conventions; recreate the site
scaffold; stage the framework and adapters from the hub; regenerate content under the taxonomy
directories; rebuild structural artifacts; refresh §1–7 and append tick records to §8.

### G1-T28 — 2026-08-30 — Tick 28: The 1997 Asian Financial Crisis, political parties and regionalism, and Han Kang deepen History, Government & Politics, and People

Added three dedicated articles — giving History an eleventh topic (the pivotal 1997 crisis and its restructuring), Government & Politics a seventh (the party system and regional cleavages), and People a fifteenth (the 2024 Nobel laureate in literature).

- Created `history/asian-financial-crisis-1997.md`: encyclopedic article on the 1997 Asian Financial Crisis and Korean economic restructuring — the debt-fueled growth model and its exhaustion (chaebol overleverage, the Hanbo/Sammi/Jinro failures, the current-account and short-term-debt vulnerabilities), the November 1997 currency collapse and $57 billion IMF standby agreement, the IMF conditionality (macro austerity, financial-sector and chaebol restructuring, labor-market and corporate-governance reform), the social costs and the Gold Collection Campaign, the Daewoo collapse, the swift 1999–2001 recovery and early IMF repayment, and the lasting legacies of labor-market dualism, elevated household debt, and foreign ownership.
- Created `government-politics/political-parties-regionalism.md`: encyclopedic article on political parties and regionalism — the TK–Honam divide and its historical origins, the Democratic Party lineage (from Kim Dae-jung's PPD through the Uri Party to the Minjoo Party) and the conservative bloc (from the DRP and DLP through the GNP to the People Power Party), the 1990 three-party merger, regional voting patterns and their persistence, the 2024 legislative supermajority, the December 2024 martial-law crisis and Yoon's 2025 removal, the June 2025 snap election, satellite parties and the PR threshold, and the gender and generational cleavages.
- Created `people/han-kang.md`: encyclopedic article on Han Kang (b. 1970) — her Gwangju origins and literary formation, the breakthrough of *The Vegetarian* (2007) and its 2016 Man Booker International Prize (shared with translator Deborah Smith), *Human Acts* and the Gwangju reckoning, *The White Book* and *Greek Lessons*, the themes of the body, violence, language, and historical trauma, and the 2024 Nobel Prize in Literature and its significance for Korean literature's global standing.
